title: Auditory-evoked spike or declared CSD response prediction
scientific_question: Can stimulus and permitted prior neural history predict auditory-evoked responses in a held-out animal using a prespecified shared region/depth target representation?
primary_outputs: Held-out-animal response trajectories in a verified shared region/depth schema: population mean spike rate per eligible recorded unit, with explicit time exposure and sampling denominator, or separately scored CSD on verified corresponding depth bins. Freeze aggregation, eligibility and missing-bin rules before evaluation. Unmapped per-unit outputs are not a cross-animal target contract; per-unit transfer requires separately specified calibration/alignment. Include continuous LFP only after its actual input is verified.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

allowed_inputs.proposed_scope: Expected source-specific input: auditory spikes/LFP with stimulus and depth/pathway metadata from the recording-bearing DANDI components; archive allocation pending.
allowed_inputs.allowed_context_policy: Only target-permitted variables may enter the query; all this task targets, future variables, answer-bearing filenames and evaluation labels stay private. Encoding receives stimuli/history with training neural responses and hides query neural targets.

biological_unit: animal; recordings, channels, trials and anatomical samples must be linked within animal
case_definition: Proposed biological-unit/session packet with nested scored observations; exact eligible cases unknown until source audit.

split.policy: Group every recording from an animal, after cross-archive identity reconciliation, and preserve whole trials. Select a single verified recording component and freeze a shared region/depth target schema, aggregation denominator and missing-bin policy using source anatomy and allowed development data before holding out animals. New-animal region/depth assignment must use declared anatomical metadata or separately designated calibration, never the scored response. No corresponding-unit assumption is allowed. A per-unit alternative needs an explicit calibration/alignment budget and disjoint scored trials before it can replace this aggregate-target proposal.
split.uncertainty: Group at biological unit, with source-specific stimulus/block dependence; do not promote neuron/trial counts to independent animals.

reference.role: Pinned MATLAB probe/layer assignment scripts. No NWB reader, shared cross-animal response target schema or complete response-onset reference is present in the inspected tree; manual setup, anatomical correspondence and source-input adaptation remain construction gates.

controls: Stimulus/timing-only and allowed prior-neural-history references use the same frozen region/depth targets, trials and input budget.
Preserve whole trials and keep scored response bins out of neural-history inputs; verify upstream processing support before claiming prospective prediction.
Freeze unit/channel eligibility, time exposure, population aggregation and missing-region/depth masks without evaluation-response-based selection.
Audit anatomical correspondence and sampling-density differences across animals; response-derived laminar assignment requires explicit separate calibration and disclosure.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Animal-macro error on the frozen shared region/depth target bins, reporting population spike-rate and CSD errors separately in declared units, exposure and aggregation denominators. Do not pool unlike outcomes. Missing-bin masks, target normalization and metric scales must be fixed without evaluation response fitting; actual anatomical correspondence and schema compatibility remain unqualified.

evaluation.comparability: Distinct assignment within a shared task family/source; no new dataset/cohort claimed for paradigms, modalities or file versions.

unresolved_grading.requirement: Freeze exact sample eligibility, target definition, primary metric, split, access rules and resource budget before outcomes.

resources.basis: Unmeasured estimate. Use bounded existing derivatives/reference features; full-source procurement and model training are not implied.

holds.requirement: Determine which of seven DANDI archives contain relevant recordings, exact labels and units; audit source licenses.

All seven archives count as one study, not seven sources. Only recording-bearing components qualify; anatomical-only files do not independently qualify. Official code covers laminar/response analysis, not a demonstrated benchmark runner. Source audit only; not execution-qualified.
Retrieve bounded versioned manifests/schema and verify actual recording inputs, labels, alignment and biological identity; catalog identity alone is insufficient.
Pin exact official code revision/entrypoint and license, inspect loader-to-data compatibility, and select a meaningful signal-derived reference.
Audit data, stimulus, code and checkpoint access/redistribution terms before packet distribution.
Freeze exact sample eligibility, target definition, primary metric, split, access rules and resource budget before outcomes.
Implement and run data adapter/evaluator/reference, matched controls and malformed-output tests; independently reproduce results before any validation claim.
